descriptions.text: Enchanted Juvenile Macropus Dominus Skin. This item fills a costume slot. This can be worn as an outer garment. You might want to protect your face, though. I'd fuck me. I'd fuck me so hard, mate. Equipping this costume imbues the following effects: Protection from Seeping Acid. A level 10 Jump skill. +5 to the Lotion Application skill. Warning: This is a 12-hour timed item.

beats.headline: Peeled off the engineer
beats.text: Genesis was supposed to bring Carl a dead joey. She hooks the engineer in Prison Pocket's pouch through the face with her grappling hook instead and drops the body at his feet, so Carl has to pull the kangaroo skin off Niels's corpse. It is stuck fast and burns his hands. It has built-in gloves with long clawed nails and palms padded like a dog's paw. He shoves his arms in and pulls the head over his own, and it clicks. His boxers and kneepads are now outside it, and his boxer and pedicure effects are negated. He turns to run at the boss and falls flat on his face.

beats.headline: Hopping into the pouch
beats.text: So Carl hops. He leaps higher and farther than he expects and lands on the outside of Prison Pocket's pouch, and the boss stuffs him in face-first. The costume's claws drag him down through warm jelly, burning, past bones, more joey corpses and a toolbox, to the bottom, where he releases his two satchels. Then he presses his kangaroo feet against the inside, hops as he phases out, and detonates in midair. When he starts to pull the costume off, the System reminds him it is a timed item.

beats.headline: Paws that can feel
beats.text: A generated gremlin leaves the truck, wrench in hand, and Carl is about to hop back from a kneecapping. Instead it hands him a note and runs off. The paper is weirdly warm. Carl unfolds it awkwardly with the costume's kangaroo paws and realises with a start that he can feel its wetness: he has sensation through the paws. It is bizarre enough that he stops to stare at their pads for several seconds.

beats.headline: Too short for the pedals
beats.text: The kangaroo suit makes it hard for Carl to reach the pedals properly, so Gluteus Maxx, the best of the strippers at Mario Kart, drives heat three, and Carl crouches between him and Donut, which is awkward in the suit too. At least it is clean-ish again after the showers. At the line Gluteus admits he has taken two of Samantha's outworlder uppers. Carl asks Donut to get her Laundry Day spell ready and get the suit off him so he can drive. No, says Donut: Mordecai said it could really hurt him, even kill him. Then the ground rumbles.

beats.headline: Feet first at the skull
beats.text: At the end of heat three Carl lies across the hood, his foot buff run out, and activates Daughter's Kiss, meaning to ram the kaiju skull with his giant feet. Dwight's cannon flips the truck, his feet hit the skull and it explodes, and he lets go of the wheel. He hits the ground and slides, and screams as his kangaroo skin flays off. Afterwards his kangaroo feet are literally on fire, and when he tries to walk on them, he falls over.
